targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo();
select coalesce(sum(spend), 0) as value from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo();
select coalesce(sum(amount_usd), 0) as value from monthly_costs where (month::date) between $__timeFrom()::date and $__timeTo()::date;

with c as (select coalesce(sum(spend),0) as v from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo()), s as (select coalesce(sum(amount_usd),0) as v from monthly_costs where (month::date) between $__timeFrom()::date and $__timeTo()::date) select (c.v + s.v) as value from c, s;

select source, sum(amount) as amount from (select coalesce(custom_llm_provider, model) as source, sum(spend) as amount from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo() group by 1 union all select vendor as source, sum(amount_usd) as amount from monthly_costs where (month::date) between $__timeFrom()::date and $__timeTo()::date group by 1) t group by source order by amount desc;

select date_trunc('day', "startTime") as time, coalesce(custom_llm_provider, model) as metric, sum(spend) as value from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo() group by 1, 2 order by 1;

select "startTime" as time, "api_key" as key, model, custom_llm_provider as provider, total_tokens as tokens, spend, "end_user" as user from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo() order by "startTime" desc limit 100;
select coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as value from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo();
select case when count(*) = 0 then 0 else coalesce(sum(spend), 0) / count(*) end as value from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo();

select model, coalesce(custom_llm_provider, 'unknown') as provider, count(*) as calls, coalesce(sum(total_tokens), 0) as tokens, coalesce(sum(spend), 0) as spend from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo() group by 1, 2 order by spend desc, tokens desc, calls desc limit 15;

select date_trunc('day', "startTime") as time, coalesce(custom_llm_provider, 'unknown') as metric, count(*) as value from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" where "startTime" between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo() group by 1, 2 order by 1;
select month, vendor, amount_usd, notes, created_at from monthly_costs order by month desc, vendor;

panels.title: Agents' credit: spent against the straight line to the budget
panels.description: The agents team's spend this budget cycle (from the gateway's ledger), against a straight line from nothing at the start of the cycle to the team's budget at its end. Both come from the team record: nothing here is hard-coded. The backlog of jomkz/agents spends toward the line in the cycle's last week.

targets.rawSql:
with team as (
  select team_id, spend, max_budget as budget, budget_reset_at as cycle_end,
         budget_reset_at - case
           when budget_duration ~ '^[0-9]+mo$' then make_interval(months => replace(budget_duration, 'mo', '')::int)
           when budget_duration ~ '^[0-9]+w$' then make_interval(weeks => replace(budget_duration, 'w', '')::int)
           when budget_duration ~ '^[0-9]+d$' then make_interval(days => replace(budget_duration, 'd', '')::int)
           when budget_duration ~ '^[0-9]+h$' then make_interval(hours => replace(budget_duration, 'h', '')::int)
         end as cycle_start
  from "LiteLLM_TeamTable" where team_alias = 'agents'
),
hours as (select generate_series(t.cycle_start, t.cycle_end, interval '1 hour') as time, t.* from team t),
spent as (
  select date_trunc('hour', l."startTime") as time, sum(l.spend) as usd
  from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" l join team t on l.team_id = t.team_id
  where l."startTime" >= t.cycle_start group by 1
)
select h.time,
       case when h.time <= now() then sum(coalesce(s.usd, 0)) over (order by h.time) end as "Spent",
       h.budget * extract(epoch from h.time - h.cycle_start) / extract(epoch from h.cycle_end - h.cycle_start) as "Straight line to the budget",
       h.budget as "Budget"
from hours h left join spent s on s.time = h.time
order by 1

panels.title: Agents' credit this cycle
panels.description: The agents team's spend this cycle, where the straight line to the budget stands now, and the difference: behind the line is credit the backlog may still use before the cycle ends.

targets.rawSql:
with team as (
  select team_id, spend, max_budget as budget, budget_reset_at as cycle_end,
         budget_reset_at - case
           when budget_duration ~ '^[0-9]+mo$' then make_interval(months => replace(budget_duration, 'mo', '')::int)
           when budget_duration ~ '^[0-9]+w$' then make_interval(weeks => replace(budget_duration, 'w', '')::int)
           when budget_duration ~ '^[0-9]+d$' then make_interval(days => replace(budget_duration, 'd', '')::int)
           when budget_duration ~ '^[0-9]+h$' then make_interval(hours => replace(budget_duration, 'h', '')::int)
         end as cycle_start
  from "LiteLLM_TeamTable" where team_alias = 'agents'
),
pace as (
  select spend, budget,
         budget * least(greatest(extract(epoch from now() - cycle_start) / extract(epoch from cycle_end - cycle_start), 0), 1) as line
  from team
)
select spend as "Spent this cycle", line as "The line now", spend - line as "Ahead (+) or behind (-) the line", budget as "Budget"
from pace
